circuit.go.src:
package main

import "fmt"

// ask prints its name, so the output shows which sides were really checked.
func ask(name string, v bool) bool {
	fmt.Print(" ", name)
	return v
}

func main() {
	fmt.Print("true && true: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", true) && ask("b", true))
	fmt.Print("true && false: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", true) && ask("b", false))
	fmt.Print("false && true: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", false) && ask("b", true))
	fmt.Print("false && false: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", false) && ask("b", false))
	fmt.Print("true || true: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", true) || ask("b", true))
	fmt.Print("true || false: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", true) || ask("b", false))
	fmt.Print("false || true: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", false) || ask("b", true))
	fmt.Print("false || false: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", ask("a", false) || ask("b", false))
	fmt.Print("!true: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", !ask("a", true))
	fmt.Print("!false: asked")
	fmt.Println(" ->", !ask("a", false))
}

true || true: asked a -> true

trace_lazy.go.src:
package main

import "fmt"

var asks int

// ask counts how many times it is really called.
func ask(v bool) bool {
	asks = asks + 1
	return v
}

func main() {
	r := ask(false) && ask(true)
	fmt.Println("1", r, asks)
	r = ask(true) && ask(false)
	fmt.Println("2", r, asks)
	r = ask(true) || ask(false)
	fmt.Println("3", r, asks)
	r = ask(false) || ask(false)
	fmt.Println("4", r, asks)
}
